summary: Iter17 P0 verification for the manual-drive foreground-service refactor (data-loss fix). Backend regression: 8/8 pytest pass in test_iter17_regression.py — /api/money (today+week), /api/dashboard, /api/reports (AU quarter, US year), /api/vehicles, /api/trips create/read/delete, and /api/ask all return 200 with valid payloads (no schema regressions from the frontend-only change). Frontend on mobile viewport 390x844: (1) Onboarding country-AU -> delivery -> Uber Eats -> own completes fine. (2) Mileage tab (/trips) renders WITHOUT red-screen — vehicle chip, TODAY 0.0 km total, business/private/percent chips, Add trip + GPS shift buttons, History toggle all render. (3) Tapping GPS shift (testID gps-start) on web produces the expected info toast 'GPS tracking needs a device build' — NO CRASH, and gps-stop button correctly is NOT rendered (tracking did not start). (4) Add trip (trips-add) opens /entry?type=trip; saving 7.3 returns to /trips; expanding mileage-history-toggle shows the new trip and its trip-del-* button; deleting removes it and shows 'Trip deleted' toast. (5) Settings tab renders with the 'Automatic tracking' section containing autotrack-toggle. Battery & background tracking row (testID battery-optimization) is correctly NOT rendered on web (Platform.OS==='android' gate) — conditional does not throw. (6) Code review of /app/frontend/src/autotrack.ts MANUAL_TASK block: TaskManager.defineTask is gated on Platform.OS!=='web'; readJSON/writeJSON persist LIVE_KEY every location batch (auto-save); startManualDrive pauses autotrack, sets LIVE_KEY active:true, starts foreground-service updates; getManualLive returns null-safe {distanceKm, startTs, active}; stopManualDrive stops updates, clears LIVE_KEY, resumes autotrack. Cold-start recovery useEffect in trips.tsx reads getManualLive() and restores tracking state correctly on app relaunch. Poll effect updates dist from getManualLive every 1.5s while tracking. Logic is correct — data-loss fix looks sound. No console errors; only known non-blocking warnings persist ('props.pointerEvents is deprecated' upstream in react-native-web, and preview 'Disconnected from Metro' cosmetic).
action_items: None. P0 manual-drive foreground-service refactor is preview-safe and does not regress any backend endpoint or existing UI flow. Physical device build required to validate real background survival (screen-off / app-kill) — outside harness scope, as noted by main agent.
critical_code_review_comments: autotrack.ts MANUAL_TASK correctly persists Live state to LIVE_KEY every batch (line 219 writeJSON) so distance survives OS-kill; startManualDrive initializes active:true BEFORE starting updates (line 239) so the task handler's `if (!live || !live.active) return;` guard cannot race and drop early points.
trips.tsx cold-start recovery useEffect (lines 63-72) reads getManualLive() and restores startTimeRef.current, dist and tracking state — correct recovery contract for the killed-app case.
stopManualDrive returns {distanceKm, startTs} even if LIVE_KEY was already null (falls back to Date.now()) — trips.tsx stopShift handles km<=0 gracefully with an info toast, no crash.

startManualDrive calls pauseAutotrackForManual() first so background auto-detection can't double-log the same physical drive; resumeAutotrackIfEnabled() is called on stopManualDrive — matches earlier iterations' invariant.

battery-optimization row is correctly gated on Platform.OS==='android' in settings.tsx (line 331) — on web this conditional short-circuits, no attempt to import/call IntentLauncher unless the row is tapped, so no runtime error in preview.

The 'unsupported on web' return path (startManualDrive line 230) is the intended behavior — trips.tsx shows the info toast and does not enter tracking state (verified: gps-stop button does not render after tap).

rca_of_issue: N/A — this is a P0 verification pass. Data-loss RCA (per main agent): prior implementation used an in-memory foreground watchPositionAsync in trips.tsx that Android's aggressive OOM-killer terminated when the app was backgrounded, losing all in-flight distance. Fix (verified via code review): (a) moved tracking to a TaskManager.defineTask(MANUAL_TASK) started via Location.startLocationUpdatesAsync with foregroundService config (kept alive as an Android foreground service with a sticky notification), (b) auto-writes running distance to AsyncStorage under LIVE_KEY on every batch, (c) trips.tsx cold-start useEffect recovers the drive on relaunch by reading LIVE_KEY, (d) Android-only battery-optimization row + first-run Alert nudge the user to whitelist GigTax from aggressive OEM battery managers. All logic paths are sound; only device-build execution can prove background survival on real phones.
